export.README.txt:
Friday Rifles quit / night: server files written by CoD2 Unbound

1. Copy server.cfg into the main folder of a Call of Duty 2 install on the server, patched to 1.3 with CoD2x installed (https://github.com/callofduty2x/CoD2x).
2. Start the server with start-linux.sh or start-windows.bat from the game folder.
3. Open UDP port 28960 to the server.

Game files are not included: use your own licensed copy.
Who can join is decided by the CoD2x on that machine: a CoD2x server takes players on its own version or a newer one.

Passwords are not included. Replace every CHANGE_ME in server.cfg before starting.

On Windows this server stays unlisted: nothing is announced.

On Linux the game's server program ignores the dedicated setting and always reports to the public master server, so the server shows in everyone's server list. To keep a Linux server unlisted, add this line to /etc/hosts on that machine before you start it:

127.0.0.1 cod2master.activision.com

A CoD2x server also reports to CoD2x's own master, master.cod2x.me.
export.start-linux.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Run from the game folder, beside main/. server.cfg goes into main/.
# The Linux server lists itself on the public master servers whatever "dedicated" says. README.txt has the way round it.
./cod2_lnxded +set net_port 28960 +set dedicated 1 +exec server.cfg

configs.config:
// zPAM
set g_gametype "sd"  // Game type: Search & Destroy
seta sv_wwwBaseURL "http://cod2x.me/zpam"  // Where they fetch them from; zPAM’s own default
set pam_mode "comp_mr15"  // zPAM’s match format: Search & Destroy · first to 16
set scr_sd_timelimit 0
set sv_hostname "Scrim Room"  // The name players see in the server list
set sv_maxclients "12"  // How many players can be on the server at once
set g_password "scrimnight"  // Password to join; empty for an open server
set rcon_password "secretword"  // Admin password, for controlling the server from inside the game; empty turns that off
set sv_wwwDownload "1"  // Players’ games fetch zPAM and its maps over the web
set sv_maprotation "map mp_dawnville map mp_matmata"  // Maps, in order
set g_log "games_mp.log"  // The game’s own log of joins, kills and rounds
map_rotate

export.README.txt:
Scrim Room: server files written by CoD2 Unbound

1. Copy server.cfg into the main folder of a Call of Duty 2 install on the server, patched to 1.3.
2. Start the server with start-linux.sh or start-windows.bat from the game folder.
3. Open UDP port 28962 to the server.

Game files are not included: use your own licensed copy.
Passwords are not included. Replace every CHANGE_ME in server.cfg before starting.

This server uses zPAM 3.36, which is not included. Download zpam336.zip from https://github.com/eyza-cod2/zpam3/releases and copy its .iwd files into main/ beside server.cfg.
A zPAM server asks CoD2x’s update service for newer versions, and players’ games fetch zPAM’s maps from cod2x.me.

The server lists itself on the public master servers. On Windows, change dedicated to 1 in start-windows.bat to keep it unlisted. A Linux server always lists itself: see below.

On Linux the game's server program ignores the dedicated setting and always reports to the public master server, so the server shows in everyone's server list. To keep a Linux server unlisted, add this line to /etc/hosts on that machine before you start it:

127.0.0.1 cod2master.activision.com
export.server.cfg:
// zPAM
set g_gametype "sd"  // Game type: Search & Destroy
seta sv_wwwBaseURL "http://cod2x.me/zpam"  // Where they fetch them from; zPAM’s own default
set pam_mode "comp_mr15"  // zPAM’s match format: Search & Destroy · first to 16
set scr_sd_timelimit 0
set sv_hostname "Scrim Room"  // The name players see in the server list
set sv_maxclients "12"  // How many players can be on the server at once
set g_password "CHANGE_ME"  // Password to join; empty for an open server
set rcon_password "CHANGE_ME"  // Admin password, for controlling the server from inside the game; empty turns that off
set sv_wwwDownload "1"  // Players’ games fetch zPAM and its maps over the web
set sv_maprotation "map mp_dawnville map mp_matmata"  // Maps, in order
set g_log "games_mp.log"  // The game’s own log of joins, kills and rounds
map_rotate
